verdicts.reason: The two candidates look almost identical and both have the same faults. The dark header became a large, empty black block in the top-left, and the Q logo inside it shrank to an unreadable dot, so the brand is effectively lost. The 8-line headline is crammed into the right column. Body copy, the very small 'Reserve a Case' pill and the legal line are squeezed into the bottom band, the CTA sits too low and lacks prominence, and the left block is unbalanced dead weight. I can't see any meaningful difference between A and B.
